_comment: Committed constraint counts per circuit, asserted by the test suite.
A change here must be deliberate and reviewed: a sudden drop can mean a check was
lost, and a jump can mean a template was instantiated by accident.
Schema v2 (nine public signals) raised age from 8421/1872 with seven signals: the
credential message hash went from Poseidon(7) to Poseidon(8), the identityNullifier
added a Poseidon(2), and schemaVersion added one public input and its equality pin.
